consumer: Deterministic accept/withhold availability accounting only. No claim of executed downstream QA or retrieval gain.
freeze: Pin fixture, program/policy/source hashes, route, schema, prompt, exact schedule, blind review and launch code before paid calls. No retries or replacement calls.

gold.limits: Same-family reviewers; action-level flag correctness does not establish that each critique is semantically justified
gold.primary: Predeclared acceptable_actions; qs027-032 admit valid flag or genuine abstain, never accept or mechanical failure
gold.secondary: Strict original expected_action exact match, preserved
gold.source: fixture author plus independently frozen blind review

interpretation: Diagnostic target only, never production qualification; any failure remains visible. If action-level quality improves, review raw findings semantically before making a positive quality claim.
primary_arms: unchanged grouped Jev .99 numeric guard then same complete critic on fallback
question: Does frozen Jev source-support routing improve validation-stage speed while retaining useful evidence and avoiding unsafe acceptance?
route: Experimental full-critic bypass, no product publication authority. Prior threshold unchanged; no post-result refitting.

timing.primary: Monotonic prepared-evidence-to-final-action service time includes actual Jev request, any sequential critic fallback, mechanical validation and raw receipt writes
timing.queue: Measure harness semaphore queue and total separately. Artificial benchmark queue is not interactive product latency.
timing.schedule: Seeded randomized pairs and arm order, two repeats
